cd /workspace/project && cat > /tmp/t1.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/project/src')
from eywa.ast import *
t = build_types([
 {'name':'I','kind':'int','bits':32},
 {'name':'S','kind':'struct','fields':[['a','I'],['b','I']]},
 {'name':'A','kind':'alias','target':'S'},
 {'name':'Arr','kind':'array','element':'I','size':3},
 {'name':'Str','kind':'string','maxsize':4},
])
m = build_modules([{'name':'m','params':[['x','A'],['ys','Arr'],['s','Str']],'result':['r','I'],
   'requires':['and',
      ['all','y',['var','ys'],['eq',['var','y'],['const','I',0]]],
      ['match',['var','s'],'[ab]*c']]}], t)
env={'x':{'a':1,'b':2},'ys':[0,0,0],'s':'abc'}
print(m['m'].requires(env), env)
print(m['m'].requires({'x':{'a':1,'b':2},'ys':[0,1,0],'s':'abc'}))
print(m['m'].requires({'x':{'a':1,'b':2},'ys':[0,0,0],'s':'abd'}))
m2 = build_modules([{'name':'m2','params':[['x','I']],'result':['r','I'],
   'requires':['eq',['add',['var','x'],['const','I',7]],['const','I',4294967303]]}], t)
print('add wrap', m2['m2'].requires({'x':7}))
m3 = build_modules([{'name':'m3','params':[['x','A']],'result':['r','I'],
   'requires':['eq',['field',['var','x'],'b'],['const','I',2]]}], t)
print(m3['m3'].requires({'x':{'a':1,'b':2}}))
m4 = build_modules([{'name':'m4','params':[['x','I']],'result':['r','I'],
   'requires':['eq',['sub',['var','x'],['const','I',7]],['const','I',4294967292]]}], t)
print('sub wrap', m4['m4'].requires({'x':7}), 4294967295-7+1)
m5 = build_modules([{'name':'m5','params':[['x','I']],'result':['r','I'],
   'requires':['implies',['eq',['var','x'],['const','I',0]],['eq',['var','x'],['const','I',0]]]}], t)
print('implies', m5['m5'].requires({'x':0}), m5['m5'].requires({'x':5}))
# empty array all is true
t2 = build_types([{'name':'I','kind':'int','bits':8},{'name':'Z','kind':'array','element':'I','size':0}])
m6 = build_modules([{'name':'m6','params':[['z','Z']],'result':['r','I'],'requires':['all','e',['var','z'],['eq',['var','e'],['const','I',1]]]}], t2)
print('empty all', m6['m6'].requires({'z':[]}))
# string const with embedded NUL
t3 = build_types([{'name':'Str','kind':'string','maxsize':3}])
m7 = build_modules([{'name':'m7','params':[['s','Str']],'result':['r','I'],'requires':['eq',['var','s'],['const','Str','a\x00b']]}], t3)
print('nul const', m7['m7'].requires({'s':'a\x00b'}), m7['m7'].requires({'s':'a'}))
PYEOF
